synopsis: ASAM's 2023 OpenX off-road workshop was followed by the “OpenX in Off-Road Applications” concept project, which was listed as active when accessed in October 2026 [f7191, f7171]. Its scope spans construction, mining, agriculture, defence and consumer recreation, covering both mobility across challenging terrain and manipulation tasks such as excavation, lifting, loading, transportation and material deposition [f7192, f7193, f7194]. The workshop and project identify missing OpenX concepts for soft and particle terrain, deformable terrain, vegetation, heavy-machinery manipulation and sensor degradation [f7195]. Despite the project's active status, the booklet considers an off-road extension unlikely before mid-2027; this is an uncertain outlook rather than a confirmed delivery date [f13212].

relations.note: Both report active project status; the glossary also adds an uncertain extension outlook.
